title: Mega Latias EX 049/063 Double Rare Mega Symphonia Pokemon Japanese Holo
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText: The Mega Latias EX 049/063 Double Rare Mega Symphonia Pokemon Japanese Holo card is a sought-after collectible in the Pokémon TCG world. Manufactured in Japan by Nintendo, this card features a Dragon attribute and is part of the Mega Symphonia set. The Mega Latias EX character is illustrated by 5ban Graphics, with a special EX designation and a holo finish adding to its appeal. This standard-sized card, suitable for players aged 6 and above, showcases the iconic Pokémon in a unique Japanese language edition, making it a valuable addition to any collector's deck.
